versions.changelog:
crypto-skill 1.1.0

- All lookups now use the Spraay free tier with batch-friendly endpoints; supports rate-limiting and improved aggregation.
- Added new batch price lookup: fetch up to 25 token prices in one call (`/free/prices`), always returns ETH, USDC, SOL, USDG.
- Gas prices now fetched for 9 EVM chains in one call, already formatted in gwei (`/free/gas`).
- Trending tokens query updated to use the Spraay free tier, with instructions for fetching full price and volume info.
- Wallet balance examples now require jq and python3 for accurate decoding of large hex values.
- ENS and Basename resolutions improved; includes public resolver fallbacks for non-resolved names.
- Token info and pairs lookup now routed through the free tier, with updated instructions to select most liquid pairs and show token details.
- Sample command-line examples now require jq and python3 dependencies.
- Removed: skill-card.md file.

Initial release of crypto-skill.

- Provides real-time crypto prices, gas data, wallet balances, token info, trending tokens, and ENS/name resolution.
- No API keys required; all endpoints are public.
- Supports major EVM and non-EVM chains: Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Solana, and more.
- Returns data for price conversions, gas estimates, portfolio summaries, and trending coins.
- Resolves ENS and Basenames automatically; includes conversion to USD for balances.
- Includes safety rules: never provide financial advice, always present timestamped data, and disclaim trending tokens.
